006package armyc2.c2sd.JavaLineArray;
007
008/**
009 * Class to provide a Point object with a linestyle to facilitate drawing.
010 * @author Michael Deutch
011 */
012public class POINT2
013{
014    public double  x;
015    public double  y;
016    public int style;
017    public int segment;
018    public POINT2(double x, double y)
019    {
020        this.x=x;
021        this.y=y;
022        this.style=0;
023    }
024    public POINT2(double x, double y, int segment, int style)
025    {
026        this.x=x;
027        this.y=y;
028        this.segment=segment;
029        this.style=style;
030    }
031    public POINT2(double x, double y, int style)
032    {
033        this.x=x;
034        this.y=y;
035        this.style=style;
036    }
037    public POINT2(POINT2 pt)
038    {
039        this.x=pt.x;
040        this.y=pt.y;
041        this.segment=pt.segment;
042        this.style=pt.style;
043    }
044    public POINT2()
045    {
046        this.x=0;
047        this.y=0;
048        this.style=0;
049    }
050}
